The [[Zaishen Elite (outpost)|Zaishen Elite]] is a [[Player versus Environment|PvE]] [[challenge mission]] designed in the style of [[Player versus Player|PvP]].

==Getting there==
[[Unlock]]ed for the [[account]] by winning against 5 different teams in the [[Zaishen Challenge]]. [[The Path of the Zaishen Elite]] leads to this outpost.
